analysis.session_summary: The full session was dominated by broad USD softness and risk-sensitive outperformance: NZD and AUD led majors while JPY lagged. VIX jumped 5.541% yet DXY slipped 0.152%, so it was not a classic risk-on tape. Fed’s Warsh, BOC Macklem and BOE Bailey all failed to provide a clean catalyst, with Warsh unscored and the others inside noise. Most intraday legs carried no clear trigger, leaving flows and headline risk to drive ranges.

themes.evidence: DXY -0.152%; USD mean vs majors -0.332%; NZD +0.448%, AUD +0.274%.
VIX +5.541% to 18.685, near the top of its 141.1-point range; Brent rebounded 3.726% after an early down leg; Gold whipsawed.
Bailey basket moved 0.001%, Macklem -0.021%, Warsh 0.051% unscored without a forecast.

currency_drivers.USD: Warsh speech gave only a 0.051% impulse with no forecast; DXY fell 0.152% overall.
currency_drivers.EUR: No own releases; held its range and weakened against most majors.
currency_drivers.JPY: Weakest major at -0.362%; no own releases and sold across the board.
currency_drivers.GBP: Bailey speech was muted at 0.001%; selling rejected and recovered 63%.
currency_drivers.AUD: No own releases; held range as second-strongest major on risk appetite.
currency_drivers.CAD: Macklem speech muted at -0.021%; CAD closed at its best.
currency_drivers.CHF: Selling rejected after early dip; no own releases, supported by cross flows.
currency_drivers.NZD: No own releases; strongest major at 0.391%, held its range.

leg_notes.EUR/USD: EUR/USD’s up leg of 56.5 pips and down leg of -47.2 pips both lacked a clear catalyst, leaving the pair within its 64.9-pip range.

polarity_reads.read: USD firmed 0.051% but with no forecast the surprise cannot be scored, so no positioning read is possible.
CAD basket moved -0.021%, inside the noise floor; the market did not reprice CAD on the speech.
GBP basket moved 0.001%, inside the noise floor; no directional GBP signal from Bailey.

scenarios.name: USD softness extends
scenarios.thesis: Broad USD softness continues, with commodity and risk-sensitive majors holding gains until hard US data or clearer Fed guidance emerges.
scenarios.invalidation: USD recovers and reverses the 0.152% DXY decline.

pair_paths.rationale: EUR held its range and benefits from the USD softness leg.
NZD was the strongest major with no own releases and risk appetite intact.

scenarios.name: CAD CPI breathes life into BOC repricing
scenarios.thesis: Hotter-than-expected CAD CPI at 14:30 challenges the muted Macklem tone and lifts CAD.
triggers: Trimmed CPI y/y stays at 1.9% or higher
scenarios.invalidation: CPI m/m at or below 0.2% with median 2.0% and trimmed 1.9% unchanged keeps CAD muted.

pair_paths.rationale: CAD gains if CPI supports a less dovish BOC path than Macklem signaled.

scenarios.name: Risk wobble returns
scenarios.thesis: VIX spike extends and risk-sensitive longs unwind, favoring JPY and CHF against USD.
triggers: US headlines on trade or Russia diesel resurface
scenarios.invalidation: VIX falls back below its 141.1-point range midpoint and risk FX resumes strength.

pair_paths.rationale: JPY catches safe-haven bid while USD stays soft.
CHF benefits from haven flows and already rejected early selling.

risks.risk: VIX spiked 5.541% to 18.685, closing near the high of its 141.1-point range
risks.why_it_matters: Positioning may be more fragile than USD weakness suggests; a reversal could hit high-beta FX.

risks.risk: Most intraday legs had no clear catalyst
risks.why_it_matters: Price action is flow/headline driven and may reverse without macro confirmation.
risks.watch: US headlines and any Fed speakers outside the calendar

risks.risk: CAD CPI at 14:30 is high impact with forecast 0.2% vs previous -0.1%
risks.why_it_matters: Can shift BOC repricing from today's muted Macklem speech.
risks.watch: CPI m/m and core measures median 2.0%, trimmed 1.9%

analysis.calendar_ahead_note: Bailey at 08:45 is the only GBP event; the main scheduled risk is CAD CPI at 14:30, with CPI m/m forecast 0.2% vs previous -0.1%, median CPI y/y 2.0%, trimmed CPI y/y 1.9%. This can reframe CAD after Macklem's muted speech.
